```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)

```

```{r}
# read in geodatabase of EJScreen data at the Census Block Group level
ejscreen <- sf::st_read('../../../../courses/EDS223/ejscreen/EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb') 
```
```{r}
# filter to a state you are interested in
california <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "CA") 

san_fran <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("San Francisco County")) |> filter(
    LOWINCOME > 0
  )


```








WE FOUND SOMETHING!

```{r}
tm_shape(san_fran) +
  tm_polygons(fill = 'P_PNPL')

tm_shape(san_fran) +
  tm_polygons(fill = 'PEOPCOLORPCT')
```
